item.title: 返信の下書きを作る AI に「メールを全部削除して」と送ってみた

item.title: Ransomware gangs keep multiplying, even as fewer victims pay
item.description: Ransomware groups listed 2,830 victims on data leak sites in the third quarter of 2026, the highest quarterly total on record, according to Check Point Research’s State of Ransomware Q3 2026 report. item.title: Google Cloud CISO talks agentic AI security and the future of the SOC
item.description: In this interview with Help Net Security, Chris Betz, CISO of Google Cloud, answers five questions about security as AI agents spread. He says the old belief that human-led workflows would stay the norm has aged badly, since attackers use automation to move through networks in minutes. Betz explains how agents could change the junior analyst role, why espionage groups can be hard to spot, which controls companies should drop, and what boards should ask … More → The post Google Cloud CISO talks agentic AI security and the future of the SOC appeared first on Help Net Security .
